title: Confirm cancellation before discarding photo edits

statement.en: Before discarding photo or video edits, ask people to confirm cancellation and explain that edits will be lost.
statement.ja: photoまたはvideo editを破棄する前にcancel確認を求め、editが失われることを説明する。

conditions: The person taps Cancel after making edits.
exceptions: No confirmation is needed when no edits have been made.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Photo editing experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるPhoto editingの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Avoid a custom top toolbar in a photo editing extension

statement.en: Avoid adding a custom top toolbar to a photo editing extension.
statement.ja: photo editing extensionにcustom top toolbarを追加しない。

title: Let people preview photo edits before closing

statement.ja: extensionを閉じる前にphoto editのresultをpreviewできるようにする。

title: Use the app icon for a photo editing extension

statement.en: Use the app's icon as its photo editing extension icon.
statement.ja: app iconをphoto editing extension iconとして使う。

conditions: Apply to photo editing extensions on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.
